title: gyrotaenia trinervata
intro: Gyrotaenia trinervata, commonly known as Bitterwood, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing fever and inflammation, as well as relieving digestive issues. The health benefits of Gyrotaenia trinervata are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and anti-diarrheal effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
